sentence_stem: Though the poet loved the sea,
correct_completion: he wrote most of his verses about the mountains.
full_sentence: Though the poet loved the sea, he wrote most of his verses about the mountains.
acceptable_variants: he still wrote many poems about the mountains.
yet he described other landscapes in his verses.

options.text: so he wrote only about the city.
options.why_wrong: 'Though' signals contrast, while 'so' signals a result. A result does not fit the contrast this connector requires.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, but 'though' needs a contrasting clause after the comma.

explanation: After 'though', the second clause must show contrast with the first clause. Polish speakers may reach for a cause connector here, so check the logical relationship between the two clauses before choosing.
